'''Ifeoma''' was the third [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Aurea]]. It had a cool, humid, and perpetually cloud-covered environment and had a bad reputation due to the uninterested population for the art. [[Ifeoma (city)|Ifeoma]] was the main city on the moon.
